name: Flame Strike
description: Level 5 Evocation (Doctor) Casting Time: Action Range: 60 feet Components: V, S, M (a pinch of sulfur) Duration: Instantaneous A vertical column of brilliant fire roars down from above. Each creature in a 10-foot-radius, 40-foothigh Cylinder centered on a point within range makes a Agility saving throw, taking 5d6 Fire damage and 5d6 Radiant damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot. The Fire damage and the Radiant damage increase by 1d6 for each spell slot level above 5.
